en: Black‑and‑white street view of a coastal town square bordered by rocky hills, early–mid 20th‑century European buildings, and several vintage cars on a cobblestone road. A railway carriage stands on a raised track to the right, with flagpoles and a small landscaped area in front. In the lower left corner the caption "STRÖMSTAD." is printed, and in the lower right there is a triangular publisher's logo with the number 7362.
